title: q-enriched-sheaf-hom
description: The internal Hom Hom(F,G) of Q-enriched sheaves on a Grothendieck site: the sheafification of the cell-wise Q-Cat_cwl internal Hom, right adjoint to the q-enriched-sheaf tensor product. It is the closing companion of the tensor that makes the Q-enriched sheaf category closed symmetric monoidal.

domain-sheaf.description: the source sheaf F of the internal Hom Hom(F,G)

codomain-sheaf.description: the target sheaf G of the internal Hom Hom(F,G)

presheaf-internal-hom.description: cell-wise Hom_p(F,G)(σ) := hom_{Q-Cat_cwl}(F(σ), G(σ)), the Q-category of Q-functors with weighted Q-hom, restrictions induced by pre/postcomposition

sheafified.description: Hom(F,G) := sheafify_J(Hom_p(F,G)); when T has enough equalizers the presheaf Hom already satisfies the sheaf condition since Q-Cat_cwl-Hom commutes with limits in its second argument

tensor-hom-adjunction.description: right adjoint to the tensor: Hom_Sh(F ⊗ G, H) ≅ Hom_Sh(F, Hom(G, H)), making the Q-enriched sheaf category closed symmetric monoidal
